'''Shortatha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] and was put in [[Prison/Legends|prison]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Gaarkhan/Legends|Gaarkhan]], another Wookiee and a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] led a mission to free him.<ref name="Star Wars: Imperial Assault Core Set" />

==Behind the scenes==
'''Shortatha''' was introduced in the starter set of the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] tactical miniatures [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Assault]]''.
